bond.name: The dragon's heart
bond.text: When any Dragon dies, on either side, Sigurd gains +2 Attack and +1 Speed for the rest of the fight.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Dig the pit
actions.text: Charge: choose an enemy hero. Sigurd spends this round hiding in a pit. Next round, when he acts, he strikes it for 8, ignoring Guard, and takes no other action. Stop him or kill him first and the strike is lost. Once per fight.
